Chat.greeting: Hey — I'm the KOGNS assistant. I'll take your brief in four quick questions.
Chat.askName: First, what should we call you?
Chat.askEmail: Good to meet you, {name}. Which email should we reply to?
Chat.askPhone: Noted. A phone number, in case a quick call is faster? You can skip this one.
Chat.askMessage: Last one — what are you building, or which problem should we solve?
Chat.success: Your brief is on its way to the team, {name}. Expect a reply within 48 hours.
Chat.invalidName: That looks a little short — what's your full name?
Chat.invalidEmail: That email doesn't look right. Mind checking it?
